opening: Your Terragrunt repo, with choudoufu as the binary. This second act adds a subnet to network. Its id is known only after apply.

pull-request.prompt: Add a second subnet to network; put a worker in it.
pull-request.reply: Opened pull request {pull}. network adds subnet b and app adds a worker in it, and edge allows the range.

pull-request.status: The workflow runs terragrunt run --all plan

planned.reply: One joint plan across 3 units. Only one value is unknown: subnet b's id, which app's worker needs.

Stock Terragrunt plans each unit on its own, so app's dependency block has no subnet b id to read and falls back to mock_outputs. With choudoufu one joint plan covers every unit, and the worker shows the id as known after apply.
planned.status: Checking how stock Terragrunt would plan app

planned.prompt: What depends on the new subnet?
planned.reply: Two resources depend on it: app's worker and edge's allowlist.

approved.status: Recording your approving review of the pull request

merged.prompt: Merge it and apply the plan I approved.
merged.status: Fetching the pull request's plan files after the merge

applying.status: Applying those plan files to all three units

tips.title: No second plan at merge
tips.body: The merge applies the files the pull request saved. choudoufu reads the live system first and stops if it has moved since your review.

tips.title: Mocks stay in the repo
tips.body: Your dependency blocks keep their mock_outputs. With choudoufu the joint plan hands app the unknown id, so the mock is not used.

tips.title: Switch the binary
tips.body: Set terraform_binary to choudoufu in root.hcl and give each unit a live block. Your inputs and dependency blocks stay as they are.

applied.reply: Done. Subnet b was created and app's worker got its real id in the same apply.

applied.prompt: Is that what I signed off on?
applied.reply: Yes, file for file. In what you saw, the worker's subnet was known after apply, and that one value was filled in. Anything else differing would have stopped the apply.
applied.status: Comparing what ran with the approved plan

applied.reply: No state lock was taken. choudoufu has no state file, so there is nothing to force-unlock. Each record is written only if it is unchanged since it was read.

closing: 3 units and 1 joint plan; the plan you approved is the one that ran.
